title: Nutty Juicy Brazilian Chicken Pasta
description: A paleo-friendly Brazilian dish featuring chicken, pasta, and a nutty emulsion sauce, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the pasta.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the bay leaves to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the macadamia nuts to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the reserved pasta water to the skillet and stir to combine with the nuts and bay leaves.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the nutty emulsion sauce.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss to combine with the pasta and sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
